mentions.name: Bazel C++ build foundation
mentions.description: This project provides a foundational layer for building C++ applications with Bazel, offering a standardized set of paths and third-party libraries that work seamlessly across multiple developer teams. Library upgrades happen transparently in the background so developers can focus on business-specific logic rather than build system intricacies. It also serves as a learning exercise for mastering Bazel.
mentions.problem: C++ developers have to deal with build system intricacies and coordinating third-party library upgrades across teams, distracting them from business-specific logic.
mentions.audience: Multiple developer teams building C++ applications.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building a foundational layer for building C++ apps using Bazel.

I am working on creating a standardized set of paths and third party libraries that work seamlessly across multiple developer teams. Allowing library upgrades to happen transparently in the background.
